name: Summer at Gwynedd
description_short: Short week camps on the Gwynedd Mercy Academy High School campus, mostly for girls, in sports, science and tech, media, cooking and the arts. Most camps run four mornings or afternoons; campers can pair a morning and an afternoon camp and stay for a supervised lunch they bring.

sessions.name: Running Camp (girls, grades 3 to 9, 8 to 9:30 AM)
Basketball Camp (girls, grades 5 to 8, 9 AM to 3 PM)
Field Hockey Camp (girls, grades 5 to 9, mornings)
Softball Camp (girls, grades 6 to 9, mornings)
3D Printing (girls, grades 6 to 9, afternoons)
Tennis Camp Session 1 (girls, grades 4 to 12, mornings)
Tennis Camp Session 2
Tennis Camp Session 3
Tennis Camp Session 4 (experienced players, grades 7 to 12)
Volleyball Camp (girls, grades 5 to 9, evenings, partly at The Armory in Horsham)
Make Your Own Musical Session 1 (girls, grades 5 to 8)
Make Your Own Musical Session 2
Triple Threat Theatre Camp Session 1 (coed, grades 9 to 12, evenings)
Triple Threat Theatre Camp Session 2
Broadcasting and Podcasting 101 (girls, grades 6 to 9, afternoons)
Power Portrait Collages (girls, grades 6 to 9, mornings)
Biotechnology and Genetic Engineering (girls, grades 6 to 9, afternoons)
Into the Deep Robotics (girls, grades 5 to 8, mornings)
Printmaking (girls, grades 6 to 9, mornings)
HSPT Prep (coed, grades 7 to 8, eight mornings)
Crew: Learn to Row (girls, grades 7 to 12, three evenings)

notes: Most camps are for girls; HSPT Prep, private music lessons and Triple Threat Theatre are coed. Times vary by camp (many are 9 to 12 or 1 to 4; some are evenings). The page header mentions summer 2027 camps, but every listed date is 2026 except the culinary camp, whose session lines mix 2027 and 2026 (left out of sessions). Soccer summer sessions (June Mondays and Thursdays, $225, sold out) and private music lessons (sold out) are not listed as sessions.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Ages derived from grades 3 to 12, not stated. Lunch is brought from home (BYO lunch hour), so meals_included is false. Price range runs from Softball ($100) to HSPT Prep ($360); private lessons ($300 and $500) left out. Address and phone from the footer.
